name: Portfolio Stack
description: A meta bar over a three-column row: a left sticky title, a middle sticky card stack (dark panels with a blurred bleeding backdrop and a sharp centered inner image), and a right sticky see-all pill; covered cards scale down and lift while the active inner image parallax-zooms.
interactions: sticky card stack: each covered card scales 1 to 0.75 and lifts -80px driven by the next card climbing over it, z-index stacking, inner-image parallax zoom, scroll + rAF drive, __sectionUpdate hook; prefers-reduced-motion removes the transforms
